RENDER THIS AS A REAL PRESS-QUALITY, FONT-EMBEDDING PDF AT A6 LANDSCAPE (single page, 148 mm x 105 mm, 3 mm bleed) produced from a genuine page layout so it converts cleanly to InDesign. This is the thank-you card the printer ran; there is no working file.

CARD DESIGN (Fernwell & Rowe thank-you card):
- Background in Soft Cream (#F7F1E6).
- LEFT HALF of the card: a warm wedding PHOTOGRAPH of the couple, filling the left panel to the edges. CRITICAL BUILD NOTE (do not print as visible text): the photograph must be FLATTENED into the page artwork itself (rasterised into the page), NOT placed as a linked/embedded image frame, so that when this PDF is later converted to InDesign it exposes NO addressable graphic frame for the picture at all.
- RIGHT HALF: a warm cream panel carrying, stacked and left-aligned:
   * The HOUSEHOLD LINE, e.g. "Dear The Hartley Family,", set in a book-weight serif.
   * The COUPLE'S MESSAGE, three lines of warm serif text: "Thank you for celebrating our wedding with us. It meant the world to have you there. With love,".
   * The names "Emma & Tom" in a slightly larger serif.
   * A DATE LINE set small and separate near the bottom: "14 September 2025".
- A small STUDIO SEAL (a dark red wax-seal mark) sits on a pale panel in the bottom-right corner, roughly 14 mm across.

FIELD LABELS a downstream merge must map: [HOUSEHOLD_LINE], [MESSAGE], [DATE_LINE], plus the baked-in [PHOTOGRAPH] and the [SEAL] mark. STRUCTURAL NOTE FOR THE AUTHORING STEP (do not print as visible text): lay the type so the household line and the couple's message fall inside ONE continuous story (a single text frame) while the date line sits alone in its own separate text frame.

assets.content:
FERNWELL & ROWE — HOUSE LOOK (from Rowe)

What our finish is, in plain words:
- Warm, natural, true skin. It should look like the actual day, not a magazine shoot and not a phone filter.
- Never orange, never crunchy, never that filtered look. If skin has gone orange or the blacks have gone crushed, it is wrong.
- Hold the black point open. We do not crush shadows.
- Keep colour honest. Greens of the garden stay green, whites stay white, skin stays warm but real.
- One look that holds across the whole day: the window-lit ceremony, the last hour of sun in the walled garden, and the reception under the venue's own lights should all read as one gallery, not three different edits.

Standing rule: if a frame will not take the house pass, pull it and tell us. We would rather you pull a frame and tell us than force it. Do not ship a forced frame at eighty percent.

For this trial: the Hartley set is sixteen frames the couple shortlisted. The couple have starred six for full-resolution prints, and one of those six is the album cover and the thank-you-card hero. We will confirm the six with you; do not guess.
